Left-back Nuno Mendes is dealing with late muscle fatigue picked up in the Wales win, but medical staff expect him to be available for selection. He is likely to be supported on the flanks by João Félix, who keeps his place after scoring the decisive goal in the 1-0 victory over Wales. ## Portugal predicted lineup. ## When will the match kick off? data.content: # Ronaldo vs Haaland: Portugal Face Norway in Nations League Showdown. Two of football's most prolific goalscorers will take centre stage when Cristiano Ronaldo's Portugal face Erling Haaland's Norway in a UEFA Nations League encounter at the Ullevaal Stadion on Sunday. The League A Group 4 clash brings the two forwards together for their first international meeting, with both teams looking to build on winning starts to their campaigns. ## Haaland's Scoring Form Puts Portugal On Alert. Norway's progress to the quarter-finals of the 2026 World Cup has raised expectations, and Ståle Solbakken's side now have another opportunity to test themselves against established European opposition. Portugal will look to exploit Norway's defensive vulnerabilities, particularly in wide areas, while the hosts will rely on Haaland's finishing and Ødegaard's creativity. For Norway, the match offers an opportunity to strengthen their position in their first League A campaign. 1.Haaland's Scoring Form Puts Portugal On Alert2.Ronaldo Seeks To Make His Mark3.Battle For Early Group Control.

data.content: Portugal prediction, lineups, odds and bet builder tips for Nations League match. Norway and Portugal meet in the Nations League in what is possibly the standout fixture of the entire international break. Erling Haaland continued his ludicrous goalscoring form for both club and country with two more strikes to seal a 3-2 victory for the Norwegians. With Portugal looking to retain the title they won in 2025 and Norway aiming to continue their ascendancy on the international stage, this has all the makings of a brilliant game. Norway are full of goals at both ends, as seen by their 3-2 victory over Denmark, and Haaland is a near-banker to score at some point. His two in the win over Denmark makes it a frankly insane 29 from his last 16 internationals and he has only failed to score in one of those games — against England in the World Cup quarter-final.
